# Nokhwa Linux bindings

Based on the Apache-2.0 licensed [nokhwa-bindings-linux 0.1.4](https://crates.io/crates/nokhwa-bindings-linux/0.1.4), upstream commit `2ea0883136a9d28361a4a72c0afbeb08b6d130c9`. The local changes let lib-cnokhwa enumerate capture nodes without setting a mode and stream with the format and frame interval returned by V4L2.
